title: Deposit
subtitle: Send crypto to your personal address. It is credited after the network confirms it.
qrLabel: QR code of your {{asset}} deposit address on {{network}}
memoRequiredText: Deposits without it cannot be matched to your account and may be lost.
wrongNetworkTitle: Check the network before you send
wrongNetworkText: Send only {{asset}} on {{network}} to this address. Other assets or networks may be lost permanently.

rules.minimum: Minimum deposit {{amount}}; smaller amounts need manual review

hold.one: Withdrawable {{count}} day after it is credited; you can invest it straight away
hold.other: Withdrawable {{count}} days after it is credited; you can invest it straight away

unavailableText: No asset is open for deposits right now. Do not send funds until deposits are available again.
announceTitle: Tell us the amount you are sending (optional)
expectedAmountHint: Creates a reference that helps support match your payment. It does not change how the deposit is credited.
referenceText: We are expecting {{amount}}. The reference is valid until {{date}}.

send.title: You send
send.text: From your wallet or exchange to the address shown, on the same network.

detected.title: We see the transaction
detected.text: It appears in your list as detected, usually within minutes.

confirmations.title: The network confirms it
confirmations.text: We wait for the required number of blockchain confirmations.

credited.title: It is credited
credited.text: The amount is added to your balance and you get a notification.

hold.title: Hold for withdrawals
hold.text: For {{count}} days it can be invested but not withdrawn.

emptyText: Deposits you send to your address appear here as soon as they are detected.
reviewNote: Our compliance team is checking this deposit. Nothing is needed from you unless we contact you.

reasons.expired: The reference expired before a payment arrived.
reasons.chain_reorg: The transaction was removed from the blockchain by a reorganisation.
reasons.screening_flagged: Held because an automated check flagged the sending address.
reasons.screening_unavailable: Held because the automated check could not be completed.
reasons.below_minimum: Below the minimum deposit; it needs manual review.
reasons.source_not_settled: The source transaction has not settled yet.

manual.subtitle: Send crypto to the address below, then tell us about the payment. We credit it after checking it on the blockchain.
manual.creditedAfterCheck: Credited after we find the payment on the blockchain
manual.reportText: Tell us the amount and, if you have it, the transaction ID. Your balance changes only after we confirm the payment.
manual.txHashHint: You find it in the withdrawal history of your wallet or exchange. It speeds up the check.
manual.txHashInvalid: Paste the transaction ID exactly as shown: letters and digits only.
manual.noteHint: For example, the exchange you sent from.
manual.reportedText: We are checking your payment of {{amount}}. You get a notification when it is credited.
manual.checkingNote: We are looking for your payment on the blockchain. Nothing is needed from you.
manual.onlyNetwork: Send only {{asset}} on {{network}}. Anything else is lost.
manual.reportHint: Linked to {{email}}. We credit it after checking the payment.

send.title: You send
send.text: From your wallet or exchange to the address shown, on the same network.

report.title: You tell us
report.text: Press “I have sent it” with the amount and the transaction ID.

check.title: We check it
check.text: Our team finds the payment on the blockchain and confirms the amount.

credited.title: It is credited
credited.text: The amount is added to your balance and you get a notification.

hold.title: Hold for withdrawals
hold.text: For {{count}} days it can be invested but not withdrawn.
